## Verification & Safety Protocols
- 10-Year Cylinder Validity Rule: Every pre-owned weapon explicitly states the manufacturing stamp and remaining ISSF competition validity window.
- Range Diagnostic Testing: Pressure regulator consistency and chronograph velocity spreads are verified prior to transfer.
- Legal Framework: Strictly 0.177 calibre (4.5mm) target air weapons generating under 20 Joules of muzzle energy under Schedule I, Category III(f) of the Indian Arms Rules 2016. No firearm licence required.
